Announced strategic partnerships to establish independent compute financing platforms with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital for the buildout of AI infrastructure over time, subject to definitive agreements.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Third-party capital platform could finance the AI infrastructure buildout, affecting demand and customer mix.

fragments.text: Announced the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform is ramping into full production with racks running at partners including CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Nebius.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Vera Rubin production with named cloud and AI cloud partners indicates deployment and customer concentration.

fragments.text: Secured land, power and shell capacity through a partnership with SB Energy at the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Ohio to host NVIDIA compute.

new_facts.why_it_matters: Secured land and power supports expansion of data center capacity.
